## Proposal / Предложение

What should be added or changed?

## Use Case / Сценарий

Who needs this and what task would it improve?

## Suggested Scope / Объем

What is the smallest useful version?

## Alternatives / Альтернативы

What workaround or alternative design did you consider?

## Research Notes / Исследовательские замечания

If this changes methodology, thresholds, data, or interpretation, explain why and cite sources where possible.
